QUOTE: "Add `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME> -0x....` in the module's public header, with one Doxygen comment and a value that doesn't collide... Regenerate with `make -C library error.c` or the CMake `GEN_FILES` target. Don't hand-edit `error.c`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a new error code means adding a Doxygen-commented #define to the public header and regenerating, and says not to hand-edit error.c.
